material_difference: Old only outlined G and had B/D finals for preset B. New leaves all G edges black, uses square C as an explicit area source and F right triangle as receiver. It targets omission of the one-half in the true right-triangle base area, not G-only cut-pyramid salience.
new_mechanism: Pair the two unit legs of square C with the two unit legs of triangle F in the same L orientation. Misusing the square area1 as the area of the right-triangular base in the removed-corner tetrahedron gives removed volume1/3 rather than1/6, hence2/3. All original triangles and edges remain, with no false length symbol.
